grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: The Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 这是为B1水平学习者设计的听力练习。听一段关于社区花园会议的对话，然后回答问题。对话为模拟材料，非真实录音。请先听两遍，再作答。
transcript:
Mia: Hi everyone, thanks for coming to the community garden meeting. We have a problem. The tomato plants are dying because the soil is too dry. Therefore, we need to water them more often. But we also have a water bill to pay, so we must be careful.

Tom: I see. If we water the plants every morning, they will grow better. But I can't come every morning because I start work at 7 a.m.

Mia: That's a good point. If we make a watering schedule, everyone can help. For example, I can water on Mondays and Wednesdays. Tom, you could water on Tuesdays and Thursdays. What do you think?

Tom: That sounds fair. But I'm not sure about Fridays. I usually visit my mother on Fridays. Maybe Sarah can do Fridays?

Sarah: Actually, I can't do Fridays either because I have a yoga class. But I can do weekends. If I water on Saturdays and Sundays, the plants will be fine.

Mia: Great. So we have Monday, Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday covered. We still need Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday. Tom, can you do Tuesday and Thursday?

Tom: Yes, I can. But who will do Friday? We should ask other people in the community. If we put a notice on the board, someone might volunteer.

Mia: Good idea. Also, we should collect rainwater. If we put a barrel under the roof, we will have free water. That will save money.

Tom: That's smart. But we must ask the landlord first because it's his building. If he agrees, we can install the barrel.

Sarah: I can talk to him. He's friendly. If I explain the plan, he will probably say yes.

Mia: Perfect. So, to sum up: we will water according to the schedule, we will ask for more volunteers, and we will try to collect rainwater. If we all work together, the garden will be beautiful again.

grammar.title: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示如果发生某事，就会发生另一件事。结构：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 can, could, should, must 用来提建议或表示义务。
grammar.example: If we water the plants every morning, they will grow better.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If we water the plants every morning, they will grow better.

questions.prompt: She is tired ______ she worked late.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
questions.evidence: The tomato plants are dying because the soil is too dry.

questions.prompt: You ______ see a doctor if you feel sick.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议。
questions.evidence: We should ask other people in the community.

questions.prompt: It is raining. ______, we will stay inside.
questions.explanation: therefore 表示结果。
questions.evidence: Therefore, we need to water them more often.
